description.message: Simulate all whitelisted browser windows as active by spoofing the visibility state event and more!

action_title_enabled.message: Enabled. The current tab (top website: $HOST$) stays active while in the background. Click to disable it for $HOST$.

action_title_disabled.message: Not enabled. Click to keep the current tab (top website: $HOST$) active while in the background for $HOST$.

action_title_unknown.message: This tab cannot be handled by this extension. Open a regular http(s) website, such as youtube.com, and click again.

action_title_reload_recommended.message: The changes have been applied to the open tab immediately; reloading the page is recommended to get the full protection.

action_title_reload_required.message: The page is still protected, but reloading the page is required to apply the change.

title_star_note.message: The "*" wildcard in your host list enables this extension on all websites. To change this, visit the options page.

prompt_reload_recommended.message:
The changes have been applied immediately. Reload the page to get the full protection?

If you skip this, some page-level protections may still be missing. You can reload at any time yourself; the R badge is a reminder until then.

prompt_reload_required.message: The tab is still protected, but this host has been removed from the list. Would you like to refresh to apply changes?

action_default_title.message: Toggle whether the current website stays active while its tab is in the background. The button announces the current state: the badge shows ON or OFF (R when a reload is recommended or required), and the button label (title) names the website and whether it is enabled. Clicking applies the change immediately to the open tab when possible.

options_events.message: Event blocking options (these options apply to enabled websites)

options_fullscreen.message: Protect fullscreen state when the page is hidden (experimental)

options_redirect.message: Block JS redirection when page is hidden

options_badge.message: Display the ON/OFF badge text on the extension button

options_reload.message: Reload the page when toggled (the old behavior; you lose unsaved data)

options_hosts_description.message: List of hostnames where the extension is active, separated by commas. You can modify this list by clicking the action button to add or remove hostnames. Enabling the extension on all hostnames with "*" is possible but discouraged, as it may negatively impact performance. Instead, limit the extension's use to hostnames that require an active tab to function properly. Example: example.com, *.example.com, www.example.com

options_all_sites.message: Enable on all websites (adds the "*" wildcard to the list). Selecting this check box adds the wildcard; clearing it removes the wildcard.

options_policies_description.message: A JSON object to prevent blocking of some events that conflict with particular hostnames. Example: {"docs.google.com": ["blur"]}

options_policies_error.message: Invalid policies JSON. Check the syntax.

guide_per_host.message: Enable "Always active Window" for specific tabs by clicking the action button once for each desired tab or by visiting the option page.

guide_entire.message: Work on all tabs (previous behavior) (not recommended)

error_invalid_tab_url.message: Tab does not have a valid hostname

error_hostname_not_found.message: Cannot find the hostname of this tab

error_registration_failed.message: Failed to register background protection. Check the extension error log.

options_invalid_hosts.message: Hostname list validation failed. Check the entries.
